verdict.rationale: Reducto is a document-processing API platform with a Studio UI, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence shows no built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. What it does show is different: natural-language parameters for endpoints like split, classify and edit; 'agentic' parse modes with custom prompts; and an MCP server that lets external agents call Reducto. None of these is an in-product assistant.
